segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour sign-on as executive producer; Case Blackwell takes the anchor desk for a post-election detox stream.

segments.title: Post-Election Decompression & China Trip Announcement
segments.notes: Case acknowledges Trump's victory, announces a week-long trip to China starting in two days, and confirms a Patreon stream tomorrow at noon; Kendelle walks through showing new ombre nails.

segments.title: Chet Check-In & Dana White Victory Clip
segments.notes: Chet appears confused about the day (thinks it's Tuesday); Case plays Dana White's shout-out to streamers (Nelk Boys, Adin Ross, Theo Von, Joe Rogan) from Trump's victory speech, prompting cultural despair commentary.

segments.title: Democratic Retirement of the Jo Rogen Experience
segments.notes: Case puts the segment to a viewer poll; Munch & Crum are tapped for a point-driven poll; channel-point redemption forces a final Rogan farewell; voice.ai crashes the broadcast repeatedly; the segment is officially deleted from Twitch.

segments.title: Hype Train Interlude During Technical Failure
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the feed while Case attempts to patch the Rogan segment; the Rogans are lost to the void.

segments.title: The Void Intrusion & Sign-Off
segments.notes: A 'Void' entity (or cover band) briefly manifests; Case closes the stream, confirms China departure, and bids farewell.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors a brief post-election detox stream, retires the Jo Rogen Experience via viewer vote, and announces a week-long China trip.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers the cold-open station sign-on as the dog producer.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walks through the studio showing off new ombre orange-pink-gold nails while Case cues her theme music.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: recurring. Appears confused about the date, thinking the election hasn't happened yet; triggers no science desk because 'science' isn't spoken.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Referenced as half of Munch & Crum for a point-driven poll on the Rogan segment retirement.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Referenced as half of Munch & Crum for a point-driven poll on the Rogan segment retirement.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: recurring. Takes over the broadcast during the voice.ai technical collapse, freestyling until the Rogan segment is lost to the void.

characters.name: The Void
characters.notes: recurring. Manifests (or a cover band thereof) after the Rogan segment collapses, briefly interacting before Case closes the portal.

lore_notes.fact: Departing for a week-long trip to China in approximately two days (from 2024-11-06); will miss next week's broadcasts and return the Monday after next. [05:10]
Patreon stream scheduled for tomorrow (2024-11-07) at noon. [05:34]

Segment officially retired and deleted from Twitch after a viewer poll and last-second channel-point redemption forced a final farewell; voice.ai software identified as the cause of repeated stream crashes. [27:34]
Software crashes the entire stream when activated; Case identifies it as the culprit and opts to run without it. [29:58]

episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosts a brief post-election 'detox' stream, processing Trump's victory with cultural despair over the Dana White/streamer tableau. The Jo Rogen Experience is democratically retired via viewer poll after a last-second channel-point redemption forces a final farewell; the segment is deleted from Twitch. Technical failures from voice.ai crash the broadcast repeatedly, prompting a Hype Train interlude and a brief Void intrusion before Case signs off ahead of a week-long China trip.
